name: Richardson Heights Village
summary: Richardson Heights Village is a community-oriented strip mall in Richardson, Texas, featuring a movie theater, diverse casual dining options, and convenient retail stores. Located on Central Expressway, this well-maintained center serves as a popular neighborhood destination for shopping and entertainment.
demographics: Richardson Heights Village serves a diverse suburban demographic in Richardson, Texas, with a strong mix of middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals working in the nearby telecom corridor. The trade area attracts residents from established neighborhoods seeking convenient access to dining, entertainment, and retail services, with typical household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000. The center draws regular traffic from families with children who frequent the movie theater and casual dining options, as well as working professionals seeking quick-service restaurants and everyday retail needs.
description: Richardson Heights Village is a well-established shopping destination located along Central Expressway in Richardson, Texas, serving the northern Dallas suburbs since its development. This open-air retail center has become a community gathering place, anchored by a popular movie theater that draws entertainment-seekers from across the region. The property features a diverse tenant mix of casual dining restaurants, providing convenient options for families and professionals alike, alongside a variety of retail stores catering to everyday shopping needs. Managed by Silver Star Properties REIT, Inc., a Houston-based commercial real estate company with extensive experience in Texas markets, the center benefits from professional property management and strategic leasing practices. With its prime location on Central Expressway, Richardson Heights Village offers excellent visibility and accessibility, making it a go-to destination for Richardson residents and visitors seeking a convenient, one-stop shopping and dining experience.
